cookieBanner.title: We use cookies
cookieBanner.description: We use strictly necessary technologies to keep this website working and secure. With your permission, we would also like to use our own analytics to understand how the website is used. You can accept, reject or choose — and change your mind at any time.

cookieSettings.title: Cookie Preferences
cookieSettings.description: Manage your cookie preferences below. Essential cookies are always active as they are necessary for the website to function.
cookieSettings.essentialDescription: Needed to sign you in, keep the website secure, remember your cookie choice and detect errors. They cannot be switched off.
cookieSettings.analyticsDescription: Our own statistics about which pages are visited and from what kind of device. Not shared with advertisers. Off unless you switch them on.
cookieSettings.marketingDescription: We do not currently use advertising or social-media cookies. If we ever do, they will only run with your consent.

settings.title: Privacy & Data
settings.description: Manage your privacy settings and personal data in compliance with GDPR.
settings.downloadDescription: Export a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
settings.cookieDescription: Manage which cookies and tracking technologies are active.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.warning: This action is irreversible. All your personal data, emergency contacts, medical information, alerts and payment history will be permanently deleted.
deleteDialog.details: Your deletion request will be processed within 30 days as required by GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure).
